'''Alebry Slemic''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempRebelSnow.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Lieutenant Alebry Slemic, including a male and female depiction]]
Alebry Slemic was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
